title: How GLM built its own inference infrastructure
why_read: A detailed engineering writeup on building custom LLM inference infrastructure is highly relevant to engineers working on ML systems at scale.
analysis: This piece describes how the team behind GLM (a large language model) built their own inference stack rather than relying on off-the-shelf serving frameworks. Such writeups typically cover batching strategies, KV-cache management, quantization, and hardware utilization tradeoffs that are directly useful to anyone deploying LLMs in production. The high comment count indicates substantive technical discussion likely comparing approaches to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and similar systems.
